notes: Added outbound webhook notifications. Everything in this tool was pull-based -- open the app, generate a report -- with no way to be told something changed without checking manually. New Settings card lets a TAM configure a Slack/Teams-compatible webhook URL with a test-send button. After every harvest, the server compares this account's fleet-wide critical risk count against the most recent prior day's snapshot and POSTs a summary only on a genuine increase (never a decrease or unchanged count), also reporting contracts newly within 30 days of expiring. Built entirely on stdlib urllib, no new dependency. The webhook URL is treated like a credential and never returned in plaintext. Verified live end-to-end with a local HTTP listener confirming real payload delivery, the Settings save/status flow, and clean error handling for an unreachable URL. Sixth of several planned operational additions -- this list is now largely complete.
